operator_semantics.PROCESS_LOCAL_MEMORY_CLOCK_SIGNAL_HANDLE: Require operation family in MEMORY,CLOCK,SIGNAL_LOCAL,IDENTITY_LOCAL,PRIVATE_CONTROL; every referenced address range privately owned by subject, signal handler approved immutable code, clock from exact enumerated clock IDs, identity target self only, resource effect confined to private subject. No external resource/credential/role/namespace mutation. If normalization cannot establish these facts=>UNKNOWN.
operator_semantics.SEALED_RESOURCE_QUOTAS: Apply all applicable quota reservations in canonical quota-ID order before effect; atomic reserve, no overflow/reset; uncertain effects retain reservation.
operator_semantics.FD_IN: Resolve source numeric slot selector to normalized RESOURCE_REF; verify complete committed retained object binding equals one of immutable expected slot handles; integer equality alone insufficient.
operator_semantics.FD_LABEL_IN: Require current committed label resource_class and authority action in exact approved set; retained identity stable through use. For a path-typed originalslot (statfs), atomically resolvepath via closed retainedroot adapter to a retainedobject resource then testlabel, never treatpathbytes asFD or reopen aftercheck. Unsupported retainedresolution=>UNKNOWN.
operator_semantics.FLAGS_SUBSET: Decode platform bits to closed symbolic set using approved ABI manifest; reject any unmapped bit; require subset of sourcepredicate and new peroperation known set.
operator_semantics.ARG_EQ: Resolve indexed original logical argument via variant ordered_fields; resource vs literal slot compares independently retained expected slot binding, pointer vs0 requiresNULL, scalar exacttyped equality. Any unsupported comparison/unknownslot=>UNKNOWN; no rawFDnumber-only authority.
operator_semantics.ARG_IN: Typed membership in exact finite predicate literal set after normalization; no ambient enum expansion.
operator_semantics.AND: FALSE if any false, UNKNOWN if nofalse and someunknown, TRUE otherwise.
operator_semantics.TRUE: True only for no additional predicate; all family/common constraints still mandatory.
operator_semantics.NO_PROT_EXEC: Reject any requested executable mapping/protection, including W+X.
operator_semantics.ANON_PRIVATE_OR_APPROVED_RO_MAPPING: Either private anonymous nonexec range in subject quota or immutable approved read-only file mapping; writes to readonly backing deny.
operator_semantics.REQUEST_LENGTH_LE: Exact normalized requested byte length<=literal bound andquota; otherwise reject.
operator_semantics.FD_EQ: LikeFD_IN with singleton expected slot; compare retained identity+label, notinteger.
operator_semantics.FD_NOT_IN: Normalized retained handle is not any protected expected slot; unknown relation denies.
operator_semantics.EVERY_POLLED_FD_IN: Each vector entry resolves to one immutable expected allowed slot retainedidentity; all entries validated before waiting, count exact/withinquota; emptyvector only explicitzero wait.
operator_semantics.EVERY_POLLED_FD_LABEL_IN: Each vector entry committedlabelclass belongs literalset; same lifetime/generation/context; events only READABLE,WRITABLE,HANGUP,ERROR,EXIT; no new handle authority.
operator_semantics.ALL_PATHS_LABEL_IN: Every source/destination path endpoint resolves under retained directory capability to committedlabel in literalset; mutation permitted only PGDATA/PGSOCKET engineprivate; APPROVED_CODE_RO read-only. Atomic retainedresolution through operation, never name-only reopen.
operator_semantics.DENY_SYMLINK_ESCAPE: Any resolution step outside committed root/identity or unresolved symlink/rename race rejects whole operation; no partial rename or fallbackpath.
operator_semantics.NO_HOST_OR_OTHER_SLOT_PATH: Reject any pathobject labeledHOST or subject!=current slot except explicitly immutable approved public material.
operator_semantics.SOCKET_DOMAIN_AND_PATH_LABEL: ExactAF_UNIX, approved endpoint retained labelPGSOCKET; no externaladdress, no arbitrary peer. Creation/bootstrap/accept only POSTMASTER and fixed enrolled sessionplan; nativeparticipants only fixed inheritedchannel.

operator_semantics.ENGINE_OWNED_DESCRIPTOR_ONLY: PARTICIPANT=POSTMASTER and all source/destination handles retainedlabelsubject belongs sameprivateengine; cannot duplicate anynative slot handle or overwriteprotectedFD.
operator_semantics.NO_INHERITED_NATIVE_SLOT_DESCRIPTOR: Reject source or destination aliases ofCTX,KEY,CHANNEL,JOURNAL,publicmaterial,targetpidfd nativehandles; no descriptor-number-only tests.
